name: com.zigurous.tweening
description:
A lightweight, type-safe, and memory efficient system for tweening object properties in Unity. A tween is an animation of a value from A to B using an easing function to create a natural sense of motion.

 Hundreds of predefined tweening functions can be called on many common Unity objects, or you can animate anything using generic tweening functions. Tweens can be controlled with many different control methods and various callback functions.
